title: Database Administrator (DBA)
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We’re seeking a proactive
 **Database Administrator (DBA)** 
 to manage, optimize, and secure our PostgreSQL, Document DB, and analytical database ecosystems. You’ll design scalable architectures for multi\-tenant SaaS environments, implement advanced PostgreSQL extensions, and enforce robust security protocols. Your work will directly enhance the performance, reliability, and innovation of our AI\-driven data platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Database Management \& Optimization:**
* Administer and fine\-tune PostgreSQL clusters for high availability, replication, and query performance (indexing, partitioning, vacuum optimization).
* Explore, evaluate, and implement PostgreSQL extensions (e.g. TimescaleDB for time\-series, pg\_partman for partitioning, pg\_cron for job scheduling) to solve unique business needs.
* Manage Document DBs (MongoDB/Couchbase), including sharding, aggregation pipelines, and indexing strategies for big data workloads.
* Optimize analytical databases (ClickHouse, DuckDB) for fast query execution and large\-scale data aggregation.


**Security \& Compliance**
* Enforce security best practices: encryption (TDE, SSL), role\-based access control (RBAC).
* Implement row\-level security, data masking, and audit logging for sensitive data in multi\-tenant environments.
* Design and execute disaster recovery strategies (backups, point\-in\-time recovery, failover clusters).


**Multi\-Tenancy \& Scalability**
* Architect and manage multi\-tenant database architectures using schema isolation, tenant\-aware partitioning, or shared tables with tenant IDs.
* Ensure resource isolation and performance consistency across tenants in SaaS environments.
* Collaborate with developers to design tenant\-specific optimizations (e.g., dynamic data partitioning).


**Collaboration \& Innovation**
* Work with backend teams to optimize ORM queries, design efficient schemas, and integrate databases with Django/FastAPI.
* Partner with DevOps to automate deployments, scaling, and monitoring (Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus/Grafana).
* Research and prototype cutting\-edge database technologies (e.g., vector databases for AI/ML workloads).


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on Database Administration experience, preferably in SaaS or big data environments.
* Expertise in PostgreSQL: query optimization, extensions, replication, and backup strategies.
* Proficiency in designing and securing multi\-tenant database architectures.
* Strong experience with Document DBs (MongoDB/Couchbase): sharding, indexing, and aggregation frameworks.
* Knowledge of security practices: encryption, RBAC, vulnerability mitigation (SQL injection, insecure APIs).
* Familiarity with analytical databases (ClickHouse, DuckDB) and cloud platforms (AWS RDS, Azure Database).
* Ability to troubleshoot performance bottlenecks in large datasets (10M\+ rows).
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Certifications: PostgreSQL Professional Certification, MongoDB Certified DBA, or cloud DB certifications (AWS/Azure).
* Experience with PostgreSQL extensions (e.g., pg\_stat\_statements, Citus for distributed scaling).
* Exposure to AI/ML data pipelines or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus).
* Scripting skills (Python, Bash) for automation and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, Ansible).
* Knowledge of DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes operators for stateful workloads).


**Why Join Us?**
* Competitive salary.
* Opportunities to work on AI/ML\-driven projects.
* Continuous learning.
* Collaborative culture with a focus on innovation.


 Apply Now

title: Delivery Consultant - Databases, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

 Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms \& Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
   

  

 You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof\-of\-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora\-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
   

  

 Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte\-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
   

  

 Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
   

  

 Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
   

  

 Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
   

  

 Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 \& s3\)
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience in advanced SQL \& ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience in Postgres, or experience in software development and experience in SQL Server/MySQL
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non\-technical leaders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of database administration experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience with the AWS platform, web services, software development, or related technologie
* AWS Professional level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience scripting for automation (e.g., Python, Perl, Ruby)
* Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR
* Experience in Database like NoSQL, or experience in any Bigdata architecture and experience in Hive/Spark/Hbase/Yarn
* Experience with massively parallel processing (MPP) databases \- Redshift, Teradata etc.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description: Resilience Manager\- DB**
**Experience Range:** 
 12\-15 years \|
 **Role Level:** 
 Manager
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Lead enterprise database resilience and recovery programs across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role is responsible for assessing database recovery readiness, validating disaster recovery capabilities, strengthening cyber recovery preparedness, and driving database resilience improvements through structured assessments, testing, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead database resilience assessments across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, cloud\-native databases, and related infrastructure dependencies.
* Design, review, and validate database recovery strategies, including recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, recovery tiering, replication, and high availability configurations.
* Plan and execute database DR tests, cyber recovery simulations, failover/failback exercises, and evidence\-based recovery validation activities.
* Assess database backup and recovery architectures for immutability, replication, retention, air\-gap/vaulting controls, RPO/RTO alignment, and restoration readiness.
* Develop cyber recovery playbooks for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios, including clean\-room recovery, trusted restore points, and database integrity validation.
* Identify resilience gaps, SPOFs, recovery risks, and operational weaknesses, and translate findings into remediation roadmaps and executive reporting.
* Collaborate with cyber security, infrastructure, cloud, application, audit, and business teams to align database recovery capabilities with business priorities.


**Must Have Skills**
* Strong database administration experience across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and cloud database platforms.
* Expertise in database backup, recovery, replication, clustering, high availability, retention management, and restoration processes.
* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry\-driven solutions supporting runbook generation, dependency analysis, recovery workflow automation, and resilience reporting.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, and infrastructure resilience concepts supporting database recovery.


**Preferred Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
* Desirable certifications include one or more of the following: Oracle DBA, Microsoft Azure Database Administrator, AWS Database Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect
* Experience in technology transformation, regulated environments, or large\-scale database resilience and recovery programs.


**Preferred Profile Attributes**
* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
